text:
maria.dev: our CI deploy job started failing in prod this morning with a 403 when the runner tries to impersonate the deployer service account. first noticed on release-42. logs show token rejected. anyone else seeing this?

sam.ops: saw a spike of 403s too around 07:12 UTC. can you paste the exact error and a minimal repro?

maria.dev: paste from the job log: `error: impersonation failed: request rejected (403) - Token has invalid audience or expired`. full line: `POST /v1/iam/impersonate -> 403 {"error":"token expired or aud mismatch"}`

raj.infra: quick checklist: 1) is CI using OIDC to exchange for short-lived SA creds? 2) any recent changes to token TTL or proxy caches? 3) clock skew on self-hosted runners?

maria.dev: yes OIDC via our GH actions proxy (gha-oidc-proxy). no config changes in repo. runner is hosted (github-hosted). different repos/jobs failing intermittently. repro steps I used locally:
```
# emulate GH action OIDC flow (shortened)
export TOKEN=$(gh auth token --oauth2)
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://oidc.example.internal/exchange?repo=redwood/release-42
# got back signed_jwt
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer signed_jwt" https://iam.redwood.internal/impersonate?sa=deployer-prod
```
The last call returns 403.
```
log excerpt:
[2026-03-15T07:11:13Z] request_id=ab12 status=403 err="aud claim mismatch: expected 'https://iam.redwood.internal', got 'repo:redwood/release-42'"
```

ops-bot: linking recent infra rollout note: https://internal.redwood/infra/rollouts/2026-03-14 - we rolled out a tightened audience validation on the impersonation endpoint.

elena.support: thanks, ops-bot. mitigation idea: the impersonation service now strictly requires the upstream token aud to be the service url instead of freeform repo string. some older GH OIDC proxies emit `aud: repo:org/repo` which will be rejected. short-term workaround: configure GH Actions to request `id-token: audience: "https://iam.redwood.internal"` or update proxy to swap aud.

sam.ops: can you share the GH Actions snippet that currently requests the id-token?

maria.dev: here's our step (simplified):
```
- name: exchange-oidc
  uses: actions/oidc-client@v2
  with:
    id-token: true
    audience: repo:redwood/release-42
```
If I change audience to the service url it succeeds in my local repro.

raj.infra: root cause sounds like the new audience validation exposed two failure modes: 1) older proxies/clients that send repo-scoped auds, 2) short TTL + network retry windows causing the signed_jwt to expire mid-flight. GH OIDC tokens default to a short lifetime (often ~60s). If the proxy or network adds latency or we do extra hops, the token can be stale by the time impersonation happens.

elena.support: suggested immediate mitigations:
- change GH action to request audience `https://iam.redwood.internal` (quick)
- upgrade gha-oidc-proxy to v1.4.2 which rewrites aud correctly (rolling deploy already queued)
- as a stopgap, increase accepted clock skew on the impersonation endpoint to 120s for older runners (config: `token_leeway_seconds: 120`).

maria.dev: switching GH action audience fixed my repro. can we get a clear rollout plan? i worry about customer repos that we don't control.

raj.infra: plan: 1) patch gha-oidc-proxy to rewrite aud to service url and deploy to all regions (ETA 3h) 2) add a temporary leeway on impersonation endpoint (ETA 1h) 3) run a job to scan recent token auds in logs and message maintainers of repos still using repo-scoped auds (automation ticket created).

ops-bot: created ticket INFRA-4721 to track proxy rollout and notify repos.

elena.support: for the customer-facing support side: send short note to affected workspaces with repro and immediate temp fix (change audience in workflow). include snippet.

maria.dev: thanks. one more oddity: a couple of jobs still fail even after GH action param fix — logs show `JWT expired` with timestamp delta ~70s. could we be hitting clock skew on github-hosted runners?

raj.infra: github-hosted runners should be NTP-synced, but transit time + proxy processing can push near 60s limit. i'll bump internal default `signed_jwt_ttl` to 180s for our proxy and add retries with fresh exchange if >30s elapsed.

sam.ops: can someone file a follow-up doc for runbook? add sections: "how to diagnose aud mismatch", "how to patch GH Actions", "temporary leeway risks".

elena.support: filing runbook doc now and will link in INFRA-4721. short message for support templates: 
"If you see 403/impersonation errors: verify id-token audience in your workflow, or use the temporary workaround to increase token leeway. Reach out to infra if your repo cannot change workflow quickly."

maria.dev: :thumbsup: closing out for now. please ping here when proxy rollout is done so i can revert any leeway changes.

raj.infra: will update. last note: we should also add an eval to Redwood Optimize to detect regressions from audience validation changes (low effort).

ops-bot: reaction added :white_check_mark: to thread and linked INFRA-4721.
